d: Lead, manage and continuously improve the Company's Information Technology function, including IFS, Infrastructure, Networks, AWS, Azure, Cybersecurity and IT Support, ensuring the delivery of secure, reliable and cost-effective IT services that support business operations and strategic objectives. The IT Manager is responsible for planning, implementing and maintaining technology solutions, managing IT resources and vendors, and driving continuous improvement across all IT services.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
Professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, AWS, Azure, Cybersecurity are an advantage.
8–10 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial role.
r: li
Develop and implement the Company's IT strategy, roadmap and annual IT plan in alignment with business objectives.
li
Lead and manage all IT functions, including IFS, Infrastructure, Networks, AWS, Azure, Cybersecurity, Business Applications and IT Support.
li
Ensure the availability, reliability, security and performance of all business-critical IT systems and services.
li
Establish and monitor departmental KPIs, service levels (SLAs) and performance metrics to ensure high-quality service delivery.
li
Manage the implementation, enhancement and support of IFS and other business applications to meet operational requirements.
li
Lead IT projects and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring timely delivery within approved scope, budget and quality standards.
li
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve operational efficiency, security and business value.
li
Develop, implement and enforce IT policies, standards and procedures in line with industry best practices and company governance requirements.
li

Ensure the effectiveness of cybersecurity controls, data protection measures, backup processes, disaster recovery and business continuity plans across on-premises infrastructure and AWS/Azure environments.
li
Manage IT risks and ensure compliance with applicable regulations, software licensing requirements and internal policies.
li
Prepare, manage and monitor the IT budget, ensuring cost-effective utilization of technology investments and maximizing return on investment.
li
Manage relationships with external vendors, consultants and service providers, including contract administration and performance evaluation.
li
Lead, coach, develop and evaluate IT team members, ensuring appropriate resource allocation, technical competency and succession planning.
li
Promote a customer-focused IT culture by continuously improving user support, service quality and end-user satisfaction.
li
Prepare periodic reports for Executive Management on IT performance, major initiatives, risks, cybersecurity, budgets and improvement opportunities.
li
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, including IFS, AWS and Azure, to support continuous innovation and business growth.
li
Perform any other duties assigned by Executive Management.

d: You’ll lead delivery of security services for clients in Kuwait, running SOC, threat detection and response, and security operations programs from start to finish.

You’ll draw on Accenture’s global delivery network (methods, tooling, accelerators, talent) and adapt it to what clients need, whether that’s a bank working to CBK cyber resilience expectations, an energy company protecting critical infrastructure, or a government entity aligning with national cyber security requirements.
You’ll be the person clients trust when delivery gets complicated, and the person teams look to for decisions.
q: Deep, hands-on experience delivering security services at scale, with strong command of delivery governance
A track record of leading large, multi-team security programs and making calls under pressure
Strong advisory and influencing skills, comfortable challenging senior client stakeholders when needed
Solid grounding in security quality assurance
Working knowledge of Splunk SIEM operations (a strong plus)
Experience in the GCC market and familiarity with regional regulatory expectations
PMP or equivalent delivery/program management certification
Splunk Core Certified Power User or Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
Nice to have: CISA, CRISC, GCIH, or GCIA
r: li
Lead end-to-end delivery of cyber defense and operations engagements, owning scope, quality, risk, and outcomes
li
Build strong relationships with client executives and stakeholders so goals stay aligned as programs evolve
li
Run delivery governance across multiple teams and workstreams, and resolve issues that cut across them
li
Raise the bar on delivery quality, using QA practices to catch problems early and keep service levels consistent
li
Keep improving how we deliver, cutting waste, improving speed, and making operations more efficient
li
Coach and develop team members, building a culture where people share knowledge and grow
li
Review outcomes after each engagement and turn the lessons into better approaches for the next one
li
Stay on top of threat trends, regulatory changes in Kuwait and the GCC, and emerging practices, and bring them to clients before they ask
